description_en: Disables the full log analysis feature for a specified domain name by calling the CloseDomainSlsConfig operation
description_zh: 调用CloseDomainSlsConfig接口关闭指定域名的全量日志分析功能
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo close-domain-sls-config --source-ip 1.1.1.1 --lang cn --resource-group-id xx --domain www.example.com --api-version 2017-12-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloseDomainSlsConfig

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

cn: Chinese (default)
en: English
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the website for which the full log analysis feature has been enabled
parameters.help_zh: 已启用全量日志分析功能的网站域名
parameters.name: domain
